name: LongVideoBench
intro: LongVideoBench 是一个面向长达一小时视频的问答基准，将采样视频帧与时间对齐的英文字幕交错输入。论文报告 3,763 个网络视频和 6,678 道人工标注的多项选择题，覆盖 17 类“引用推理”问题，用于检验大型多模态模型对长程视频上下文的感知与关系推理能力。
build_method: 按非连续时长段与内容类别收集 720P+ 视频，经英文字幕或 Whisper-V3-Large、Q-Align > 0.25 与人工过滤后，由三角色流程标注引用推理多选题
metric: 多项选择准确率（总体、时长组、问题类别）
eval_feature: 零样本；采样帧与字幕交错输入；验证集选择帧预算；隐藏测试标签
scale: 论文：3,763 个视频、6,678 题；固定公开 Meta：1,337 条验证 + 5,341 条测试，引用 3,761 个唯一视频 ID
build_method_en: Collect 720P+ videos across non-contiguous duration bands and content categories; apply English-subtitle or Whisper-V3-Large processing, Q-Align > 0.25 and human filtering; then author referring-reasoning MCQs under three-role quality control
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot; interleaved sampled frames and subtitles; validation-selected frame budget; hidden test labels
intro_en: LongVideoBench is a QA benchmark for videos up to one hour long, presented as interleaved sampled frames and timestamp-aligned English subtitles. The paper reports 3,763 web videos and 6,678 human-authored multiple-choice questions across 17 referring-reasoning categories, testing long-context perception and relation reasoning in large multimodal models.
scale_en: Paper: 3,763 videos and 6,678 questions; pinned public Meta: 1,337 validation + 5,341 test rows referencing 3,761 unique video IDs
metric_en: Multiple-choice Accuracy (overall, duration group, question category)

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against the official 30-page NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks camera-ready paper (PDF generated 2024-10-30), which is newer than the sole arXiv v1 submission and the cached CDN copy. The construction path follows the paper's four non-contiguous duration bands—(8s,15s], (15s,60s], (180s,600s], and (900s,3600s]—and ten content categories. In April 2024 the authors used official platform APIs to collect 720P-or-better videos from 119 channels (99 landscape and 20 portrait). Platforms with transcripts reject missing or non-English transcripts; platforms without supplied transcripts use Whisper-V3-Large. Topic/category sampling is followed by Q-Align filtering at score > 0.25 and human rejection of still-frame or incomplete-subtitle videos. Experienced contractors in a controlled lab watch each full video with timestamp-aligned subtitles, author L1 Perception or L2 Relation referring-reasoning MCQs in 17 categories with one correct answer and 3–4 relevant distractors, highlight the referring query, and mark every referred frame index. A primary annotator, examiner, and reviser perform quality control; about 20% of items are flagged and revised. The paper reports 3,763 videos and 6,678 questions, with no train split: validation has 1,337 questions / 752 videos and public labels, while test has 5,341 questions / 3,011 videos and hidden labels. Its prose for per-video question allocation is internally ambiguous for videos longer than 60 seconds, so the diagram does not invent a per-video question rule. Reproducibility boundaries were checked at three fixed revisions: official loader commit fc3c553250cfee6853a722f9b181f1b69f478426, gated main dataset snapshot 60d1c89c1919a198b73be39c2babb213b29d6a5c, and public metadata snapshot cdf3444602208c95f453e7683583a077ce38ddbf. The public metadata contains exactly 1,337 validation and 5,341 test rows, but references 753 and 3,008 unique video IDs respectively (3,761 total, with no split overlap), rather than the paper's 752 / 3,011 split counts; the graph explicitly preserves both claims instead of silently reconciling them. Validation correct_choice values are 0–4; every public test value is the −1 sentinel. The main dataset is gated under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial use, and source owners retain video copyright, so openness is classified as partly public. The pinned loader uniformly samples num_frames = min(frame budget, int(duration)) at no more than 1 fps, interleaves a subtitle only when a sampled frame falls within its time span, appends the question and lettered choices, and requests the option letter directly; it does not request chain-of-thought or use an auxiliary judge. The paper selects a frame setting on validation (sweeping 1–256 for long-context models) and evaluates test zero-shot with that setting. The pinned GitHub repository contains a loader but no native scorer; its README delegates automatic validation to a mutable LMMs-Eval main branch. The official leaderboard Space revision a7648b5f14ce5afaee82508f52a5007d175a801d accepts letter-first JSON submissions and directs users to email for hidden test scoring, but exposes neither hidden references nor the exact test parser/scorer. Accordingly, the diagram distinguishes paper protocol, observable loader behavior, public release contents, and private test evaluation.
